title: RNA Isolation from Plant Tissue Using Hot Acid Phenol Method
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.4rxgv7n

steps.title: Prepare Extraction Tube
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL of saturated acid phenol (pH 4.3) and 3 mL of RNA extraction buffer to a 15 ml snap cap tube and warm to 65 °C in a fume hood using a heat block.

steps.title: Homogenize Plant Tissue
steps.instruction: Homogenize plant tissue in liquid nitrogen using a mortar and pestle.

steps.title: Extract RNA from Tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 1.0 g of ground tissue to the warmed phenol-buffer mixture using a spatula and funnel chilled in liquid nitrogen.

substeps.instruction: Close the snap cap tube completely (second stop).
Immediately mix the tube by hand.
Vortex until the phases mix and appear cloudy.
Maintain at Room temperature or 65 °C depending on whether SDS is precipitating.

steps.title: First Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture for 00:10:00 and transfer the aqueous phase to a new 15 ml tube.

steps.title: Chloroform Wash
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL of chloroform:isoamyl (24:1 ratio) to the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Close the snap cap tube completely (second stop) and mix immediately by hand.
Vortex until the phases mix and appear cloudy.
Centrifuge for 00:10:00.
Transfer the aqueous phase to a new 15 ml tube.

steps.title: Precipitate Nucleic Acids
steps.instruction: Precipitate nucleic acids by gently adding 3 mL of isopropanol to the tube, followed by gentle inversion to mix.

substeps.instruction: Precipitate for 01:00:00 at 4 °C.
Centrifuge for 00:10:00.
Remove the supernatant without dislodging the pellet.

steps.title: Wash RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Rinse the pellet with 1 mL of chilled 70% ethanol made with RNase-free H2O.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the pellet and ethanol to a new 1.5 ml tube and invert to wash.
Centrifuge in a microcentrifuge for 00:02:00 and remove the supernatant.

steps.title: Spin-Dry RNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Spin-dry the RNA pellet by successive 00:01:00 centrifugations at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge, removing any remaining liquid after each spin.

substeps.instruction: Repeat until no liquid is seen when the tube is flicked.
Air dry the pellet for 00:01:00 to 00:05:00 depending on pellet size (avoid over-drying).

steps.title: Re-suspend and LiCl Precipitation
steps.instruction: While on ice, re-suspend the pellet in 500 µL RNase-free H2O using gentle pipetting.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 4 Molarity (M) LiCl.
Precipitate the RNA overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Recover and Wash RNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 00:30:00 at 4 °C in a microcentrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Wash the pellet three times with 200 µL of chilled 70% ethanol diluted in RNase-free H2O.
Centrifuge at 4 °C between washes.
Remove the pellet from the tube wall during washes to ensure completeness.
Carefully remove supernatant between washes.

steps.title: Final Drying and Dissolution
steps.instruction: Spin the pellet and remove ethanol, then dry the pellet as described in the spin-dry step (maximum speed centrifugations and air drying).

substeps.instruction: Dissolve the pellet in RNase-free H2O on ice (standard starting point is 50 µL, adjusted for pellet size/viscosity).

steps.title: Quality Control
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the RNA extract for 00:01:00 at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Check concentration and integrity using a NanoDrop 2000 spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Purification and DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Purify and DNase treat up to 100 µg of RNA using a Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit spin column (pink).

substeps.instruction: Follow the 'RNA Cleanup' protocol in the RNeasy Handbook.
Perform on-column DNase digestion with the Qiagen RNase-Free DNase Set.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute RNA from the column using 95 °C RNase-free water.

substeps.instruction: If RNA mass is ≥ 50 µg: Elute twice using 40 µL each time (total 80 µL).
If RNA mass is < 50 µg: Use only 40 µL for elution.
